messages.author: 1e1f6c27d3c442a5
messages.subject: IO data chain: reactiveUI -> input$ -> reactiveUI
parts:
Hi, 

I try to implent a "multiple steps" reactive :
============= ui.R
...
uiOutput("input.1"),
...
=============
============= server.R
input.1 <- reactiveUI(function() { 
    return(tags$textarea(id="texteditor",""))
})

output.2 <- reactiveUI(function() { 
    ...
   input$input.1
})
=============
// Note that the textarea is an editable component, which should be modified by user on client side, and this is why I need to call input$input.1 to get its actual content.

This works well: input$input.1 holds the content of the textarea.

Now, if I need to encaplulate the textarea in a div (because I need to concatenate with others components), I cannot find the way to get the textarea content.
============= server.R
input.1 <- reactiveUI(function() { 
    return(tags$div(
        tags$textarea(id="texteditor",""), #some more tags
    )
})

output.2 <- reactiveUI(function() { 
    ...
   input$input.1
})
=============

I expected input$input.1 will be a quite complicated object of kind div>textarea,... and I whish like to access to the content of the textarea.
But in fact, if I print this object ( "str( input$input.1 )" ), it returns a NULL...

So, how to manage a "complicated" 'input$x' object ?

Best regards,

messages.author: 1e1f6c27d3c442a5
messages.subject: Re: IO data chain: reactiveUI -> input$ -> reactiveUI
parts:
Ok, I made a mistake. Everything is working fine in the following (real) example.
I post it in case it should be intersting for somebody.

Thanks,

============= ui.R
library(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(  
  headerPanel("Title"),
  sidebarPanel(),
  
  mainPanel(
    uiOutput("input.1"),
    h2("copy of input.1:"),
    textOutput("output.2")
  )
))
=============
============= server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    
  output$input.1 <- reactiveUI(function() { 
    return(
      # works: textInput(label="",inputId="input.1","abcd")
      # works, too: tags$textarea(id="input.1","abcde")
      # also working: 
      tags$div(tags$textarea(id="input.1","abcde"),tags$b("BOLD!"))
    )
  })
  
  
  output$output.2 <- reactiveText(function() {
    input$input.1
  })
  
})
=============
